theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E], ∃ S : Finset ℕ, ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ℓ.Prime → ℓ ∉ S → ∀ V : ValuationSubring E, V.LiesOverPrime ℓ → ∀ τ : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, τ ∈ V.inertiaSubgroupIn ℚ → τ = 1
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted integral primitive generation and conjugate separation: outside finitely many primes, inertia fixes the primitive generator and hence the entire field.
